Market today: Higher Treasury yields are the big story, pushing down growth stocks. China's Taiwan warning adds geopolitical risk to chip names. This is a tough environment for your tech-heavy, margin-fueled book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.21%) and SPAL (-31.89%) are deep in the red. These leveraged ETFs decay and are extra painful on margin. METU (+42.11%) is a strong performer but also leveraged. Drawdowns on these hurt extra.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield; continued rises will pressure your tech names. Also, monitor any escalation around China/Taiwan for chip sector impact.

Bottom line: De-risking your leveraged losers is critical in this environment.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are down significantly (-34.21%, -31.89%) and decay. Consider reducing exposure to manage risk, especially on margin.
Watch SNOW: Your SNOW position is up slightly (+1.47%). The scanner shows a "WATCH" setup (entry 339.22-338.88, stop 337.88) with good value, but market headwinds suggest caution.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The current market environment with rising yields and geopolitical tension makes new long positions risky without strong conviction.
